instructions.landmark: Record element, reference bounds/coordinate space, alignment, relative scale, layer order, protected regions and narrow adaptation. Select tolerances from this design, not a universal similarity threshold.
instructions.asset_slot: Record route/region, reference/hash, pose/gesture/gaze/expression/props, identity anchor, actual generation attachments/prompt, raw/master/export hashes, dimensions, visible subject bounds, responsive crop and reuse rationale. For cutouts, link solid light/dark/project-background and full-resolution edge/gap reviews; record findings and final export review separately from alpha stats.
instructions.comparison: Record route/state, reference/hash, actual capture/hash, loaded asset versions, viewport/DPR, font/image readiness, tool/version/command/options, comparison-only crops/resizes/masks, diff path/result, focal-region findings, fixes and rerun evidence. Mark unavailable checks as unavailable, not passed.
instructions.adaptation: Record region, reason (responsive/accessibility/real content or user-selected new direction), evidence and any required user choice. Preserve original mockups; never backfill them from code.
